summary: McFarland, USA is a 2015 American sports drama film directed by Niki Caro and produced by Walt Disney Pictures and Mayhem Pictures. It is based on the true story of a 1987 cross country team from a mainly Latino high school in McFarland, California. Kevin Costner stars as Jim White, the school's coach, who leads the team to a state championship.
one_line: A 2015 Disney sports drama, directed by Niki Caro, based on a 1987 McFarland, California high school cross country team's state championship.
key_facts: McFarland, USA is a 2015 American sports drama film directed by Niki Caro.
The film is also known as McFarland.
Mark Ciardi and Gordon Gray produced McFarland, USA.
The screenplay was written by Christopher Cleveland, Bettina Gilois and Grant Thompson.
Music for McFarland, USA was composed by Antônio Pinto.
The film was co-produced by Walt Disney Pictures and Mayhem Pictures.
McFarland, USA is based on the true story of a 1987 cross country team.
The team came from a mainly Latino high school in McFarland, California.
Kevin Costner stars as Jim White, the school's coach.
Jim White leads the team to win a state championship.
Maria Bello co-stars in the film.
Morgan Saylor co-stars in the film.
